_what_this_is: the discover step's proposals (model call); the confirm step looks each up in the registries

proposals.title: Effectiveness of interventions for improving educational outcomes for people with disabilities in low- and middle-income countries: A systematic review
proposals.why: Most recent Campbell systematic review of 28 studies on what works to improve educational outcomes for people with disabilities in LMICs.

proposals.title: Implementation of Inclusive Education: A Systematic Review of Studies of Inclusive Education Interventions in Low- and Lower-Middle-Income Countries
proposals.container: International Journal of Disability, Development and Education
proposals.why: First systematic review of interventions to improve inclusive education for students with disabilities in low- and lower-middle-income countries; 31 studies across 19 countries.

proposals.title: Inclusion Matters: Inclusive Interventions for Children with Disabilities – An evidence and gap map from low- and middle-income countries
proposals.why: Updated 2024 UNICEF evidence and gap map on inclusive interventions for children with disabilities in LMICs, covering health, education, and social services.

proposals.title: Evidence and gap map of studies assessing the effectiveness of interventions for people with disabilities in low-and middle-income countries
proposals.why: Campbell evidence and gap map covering 59 systematic reviews and 50 impact evaluations on disability interventions in LMICs, including education outcomes.

proposals.title: Rapid Evidence Assessment (REA) of What Works to Improve Educational Outcomes for People with Disabilities in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
proposals.container: Campbell Collaboration and International Centre for Evidence in Disability
proposals.why: DFID-commissioned rapid evidence assessment of 24 studies on effective interventions for educational outcomes for people with disabilities in LMICs.

proposals.title: Inclusive Education and Children with Disabilities: Quality Education for All in Low and Middle Income Countries
proposals.why: Systematic literature review of 131 articles on strategies and quality education outcomes for children with disabilities in LMICs, commissioned by CBM.

proposals.title: A systematic review of academic performance of Children with Disabilities (CWDs) in inclusive education schools in Low and Middle-Income Countries (LMICs)
proposals.why: Systematic review evaluating school access, enrolment, attendance, and academic results of children with disabilities in inclusive schools in LMICs.

proposals.title: Policy Guidelines on Inclusion in Education
proposals.why: UNESCO policy guidelines providing frameworks and recommendations for inclusive education systems, including for children with disabilities in developing countries.
